title: Action This Day
original_lyrics:
[verse]
together really quick.
Nice and easy, and ill supply the main riff for it as well. Enjoy!
Action
This street honey is mean street
Living in thIS street honey needsa mean streak
We've got criminals living in this street

[bridge]
Like jukebox playing the same dead record
Or radio in the corner keeps blaring
I gotta feeling, this world is using me
This town honey is dead town
Living in this town honey is showdown

[bridge]
Some sunshine ray through crack in shutter
Or sight of light at
The end of tunnel
Still there's feeling, this world is using me
Action this day
Action this night
We've gotta learn to learn to live to love
You can't say it ain't right
Action this day
Action this night
You've got the power, you've got the power
You've got the power to love and to live
You can't say it ain't right
Your mind honey is bleak place
Living in your mind's living in bleak place
Your mind is coming from rat race

[bridge]
Like jukebox playing the same dead record
Or radio in the corner keeps blaring
I gotta feeling that just won't quit, this world is using me
Action this day...
Please don't forget to rate and comment correctives. Thanks!
